server_id_conflict: you are logged in on a different device.
not_allowed: perxa has been rejected, this is normally due to sending packets too fast, please try again later.
bad_packet: Bad packet, this happens when the client sends a bad packet to the server.
version_mismatch: Version mismatch, please report this to a developer due to this been a internal bug.
skin_issue: The client skin had a issue, please report this to a developer for a gift!
server_full: Wow this server is popular! Check back later.
internal_server_error: I'm sorry, but something went wrong on our end. Please try again later.
logged_in_other_location: The same account logged into the realm while another instance was running, this caused a conflict.
unexpected_packet: It appears perxa has sent a packet too fast and the server dropped our connection.
host_disconnected: Nethernet peer suddenly closed, the realm has crashed.
